## Project Overview

This reproducible pattern generates a **Women's Size S/M 100% Cotton Mitered Chevron Halter Top** calibrated for an **~88 cm bust / ~76 cm underbust** (`38.0 cm` front panel baseline + `2 × 14.0 cm` ribbed back extensions + `10.0 cm` corset lace-up gap).

Unlike naive chevron patterns that assume square stitches, every stitch count, short-row turn, blueprint polygon, and yardage estimate on this page is computed dynamically in R from Euclidean trigonometry using the true aspect ratio of half double crochet (`sts/cm != rows/cm`). Edit any gauge or measurement variable in the setup chunk below and re-render with Quarto to recalibrate the entire pattern.

---

## 1. Parameterized R Setup & Trigonometric Stitch Engine

```{r}
#| label: setup-parameters
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. TUNABLE GARMENT, YARN & GAUGE PARAMETERS
# ==============================================================================

# Yarn specifications: Sport weight (#2) 100% cotton (125 m / 50 g)
yarn_weight_class   <- "Sport (#2) 100% Mercerized/Combed Cotton"
skein_meters        <- 125.0
skein_grams         <- 50.0
meters_per_gram     <- skein_meters / skein_grams
yardage_buffer      <- 1.15  # +15% safety buffer

# 4-color palette & 2-row stripe sequence (C2 -> C3 -> C4 -> C1)
palette_df <- tibble::tibble(
  code = c("C1", "C2", "C3", "C4"),
  name = c("Forest Green", "Ochre / Mustard", "Cream", "Dusty Rose"),
  hex  = c("#2E5A36", "#B87B28", "#F3EAD6", "#D99B96"),
  role = c(
    "Body stripe 4 + Ribbed band + Cutout border + I-cord straps",
    "Body stripe 1 + Final collar/armhole sc framing row",
    "Body stripe 2",
    "Body stripe 3"
  )
)
stripe_cycle_codes <- c("C2", "C3", "C4", "C1")
rows_per_stripe    <- 2L

# Hooks (mm)
hook_body_mm <- 3.0  # Main hdc mitered chevron body
hook_trim_mm <- 2.5  # sc BLO ribbed band, inner cutout border & 3-st I-cords

# Main body gauge (3.0 mm hook in hdc): 22 sts x 16 rows = 10 x 10 cm
sts_per_cm  <- 2.2
rows_per_cm <- 1.6

# Ribbed band & trim gauge (2.5 mm hook in sc BLO): 24 sts x 26 rows = 10 x 10 cm
band_sts_per_cm  <- 2.4
band_rows_per_cm <- 2.6

# Target garment geometry (cm) -- calibrated for Size S/M (~76 cm underbust / ~88 cm bust)
# Cutout tuning guide: 4.5 = modest sternum | 9.0 = deep keyhole | 11.0 = almost-underboob | 12.5 = bold underboob
front_width_cm       <- 38.0  # Total flat horizontal baseline across front ribs
cutout_height_cm     <- 11.0  # 90-deg almost-underboob inverted-V cutout (base = 2 * 11.0 = 22.0 cm)
body_height_cm       <- 21.0  # Top of waistband (y = 0) to flat halter collarbone edge
neck_flat_width_cm   <- 9.0   # Blunted horizontal top collar width
band_height_cm       <- 4.5   # Perpendicular sc BLO underbust band height
band_total_length_cm <- 66.0  # 38 cm front (incl. 22 cm cutout bridge) + 2 x 14 cm back
back_gap_cm          <- 10.0  # Open corset lace-up gap at center back (66 + 10 = 76 cm)
icord_length_cm      <- 160.0 # Length of each 3-stitch I-cord strap (x2 straps)
icord_stitches       <- 3L
```

### Exact Mitered Trigonometric Engine

Because `hdc` stitches are narrower than they are tall (`1 / sts_per_cm = 0.455 cm` wide vs. `dT = 1 / rows_per_cm = 0.625 cm` perpendicular row thickness), naive `+1` or `+2` increases every row distort the `90°` chevron angle:

- **Perpendicular row thickness:** $dT = 1 / \text{rows\_per\_cm}$. Along a $45^\circ$ chevron leg, advancing perpendicular to the leg by $dT$ shifts the vertical spine peak upward by $\Delta y_{\text{spine}} = dT\sqrt{2}$ and shifts a horizontal $180^\circ$ rib baseline outward by $\Delta x_{\text{rib}} = dT\sqrt{2}$.
- **90° Center Peak & 180° Rib Baseline Rate:** Projecting the new vertex back onto the previous $45^\circ$ leg yields an exact leg extension of $dT / \tan(45^\circ) = dT$ cm per row at the spine (and likewise $+dT$ cm per row at the flat horizontal rib edge), requiring:
  $$r_{\text{miter}} = dT \times \text{sts\_per\_cm} = \frac{\text{sts\_per\_cm}}{\text{rows\_per\_cm}} = 1.375 \text{ sts/row/wing}$$
  Our engine tracks exact cumulative Euclidean arc length with staggered tie-breaking between `+1` (`(1 hdc, ch 1, 1 hdc)`) and `+2` (`(2 hdc, ch 1, 2 hdc)`) so stitch counts never drift by more than `0.5` stitches (`~2 mm`) on any row.
- **Armhole Side-Bust Pivot Condition:** Decreasing `k` stitches at the row end shortens the leg by $s = k / \text{sts\_per\_cm}$, shifting the outer coordinate by $\Delta x = (dT - s)/\sqrt{2}$ and $\Delta y = (dT + s)/\sqrt{2}$. A single `hdc2tog` (`k = 1`, $s = 0.455\text{ cm} < dT = 0.625\text{ cm}$) actually drifts *outward* ($\Delta x = +0.12\text{ cm/row}$). To pivot strictly **upward and inward** ($\Delta x < 0$), the engine computes $k_{\text{dec}} = \lfloor r_{\text{miter}} \rfloor + 1 = 2$ (`[hdc2tog] 2x` at outer edges, giving $\Delta x = -0.20\text{ cm/row}, \Delta y = +1.08\text{ cm/row}$).

```{r}
#| label: trigonometric-engine
build_chevron_halter <- function(
  sts_per_cm, rows_per_cm, band_sts_per_cm, band_rows_per_cm,
  front_width_cm, cutout_height_cm, body_height_cm, neck_flat_width_cm,
  band_height_cm, band_total_length_cm, icord_length_cm,
  palette_df, stripe_cycle_codes, rows_per_stripe = 2L
) {
  # Fundamental differential geometry constants
  dT         <- 1 / rows_per_cm
  ds         <- 1 / sts_per_cm
  step_c     <- dT * sqrt(2)            # Intercept advance along x + y = c per hdc row
  rate_miter <- dT * sts_per_cm         # Exact sts/row/wing for 90-deg miter & 180-deg base

  # Cutout & Phase 1 foundation geometry
  cutout_base_cm <- 2 * cutout_height_cm
  cutout_leg_cm  <- cutout_height_cm * sqrt(2)
  leg0_sts       <- as.integer(round(cutout_leg_cm * sts_per_cm))
  fsc_total_sts  <- 2L * leg0_sts + 1L  # Odd count: leg + 1 marked center st + leg

  # Row milestones across phases
  rib_wing_target_cm <- (front_width_cm - cutout_base_cm) / 2
  n_rib_rows  <- as.integer(round(rib_wing_target_cm / step_c))
  n_peak_rows <- as.integer(round((body_height_cm - cutout_height_cm) / step_c))
  n_neck_rows <- as.integer(round((neck_flat_width_cm / 2) / step_c))
  n_hdc_rows  <- n_peak_rows + n_neck_rows

  # Minimum outer-edge decrease so dx = (dT - k*ds)/sqrt(2) < 0 (strictly inward taper)
  dec_outer_sts <- as.integer(floor(rate_miter) + 1L)

  color_lookup <- setNames(
    paste0(palette_df$code, " (", palette_df$name, ")"),
    palette_df$code
  )
  hex_lookup <- setNames(palette_df$hex, palette_df$code)

  # Initialize state trackers
  rows_list      <- list()
  poly_list      <- list()
  wing_sts       <- leg0_sts
  cum_peak_exact <- 0.0; cum_peak_int <- 0L
  cum_rib_exact  <- 0.0; cum_rib_int  <- 0L
  cum_neck_exact <- 0.0; cum_neck_int <- 0L

  # Row 0: Phase 1 Foundation Arch (fsc framing cutout in C2 so first stripe begins cleanly)
  first_code <- stripe_cycle_codes[1]
  rows_list[[1]] <- tibble::tibble(
    Row              = "Row 0 (Fdn)",
    row_num          = 0L,
    Phase            = "Phase 1: Foundation Arch",
    color_code       = first_code,
    Color            = color_lookup[[first_code]],
    Row_Start_Action = paste0("fsc ", leg0_sts, " (right leg)"),
    Center_Action    = "1 fsc (mark center spine st)",
    Row_End_Action   = paste0("fsc ", leg0_sts, " (left leg)"),
    Wing_Sts         = leg0_sts,
    Total_Sts        = fsc_total_sts,
    Active_HDC_Equiv = fsc_total_sts
  )

  # Physical coordinate state for right-half polygons (mirrored to left half x -> -x)
  y_collar_actual <- cutout_height_cm + n_peak_rows * step_c
  x_out_bot       <- cutout_height_cm
  y_out_bot       <- 0.0

  for (r in seq_len(n_hdc_rows)) {
    c_code <- stripe_cycle_codes[((r - 1L) %/% rows_per_stripe) %% length(stripe_cycle_codes) + 1L]
    c_bot  <- cutout_height_cm + (r - 1L) * step_c
    c_top  <- cutout_height_cm + r * step_c

    if (r <= n_rib_rows) {
      phase_label <- "Phase 2: Rib Baseline"
      # Staggered rounding tie-breakers keep wing_sts within <= 0.5 st of exact Euclidean length
      cum_peak_exact <- cum_peak_exact + rate_miter
      inc_peak       <- as.integer(floor(cum_peak_exact + 0.5)) - cum_peak_int
      cum_peak_int   <- cum_peak_int + inc_peak

      cum_rib_exact  <- cum_rib_exact + rate_miter
      inc_rib        <- as.integer(ceiling(cum_rib_exact - 0.5)) - cum_rib_int
      cum_rib_int    <- cum_rib_int + inc_rib

      wing_sts  <- wing_sts + inc_rib + inc_peak
      total_sts <- 2L * wing_sts + 1L

      start_act <- sprintf("+%d st (%d hdc in 1st st)", inc_rib, inc_rib + 1L)
      peak_act  <- sprintf("(%d hdc, ch 1, %d hdc) [+%d/wing]", inc_peak, inc_peak, inc_peak)
      end_act   <- sprintf("+%d st (%d hdc in last st)", inc_rib, inc_rib + 1L)

      x_in_bot <- 0.0;   y_in_bot <- c_bot
      x_in_top <- 0.0;   y_in_top <- c_top
      x_out_top <- c_top; y_out_top <- 0.0

    } else if (r <= n_peak_rows) {
      phase_label <- "Phase 3: Armhole Taper"
      cum_peak_exact <- cum_peak_exact + rate_miter
      inc_peak       <- as.integer(floor(cum_peak_exact + 0.5)) - cum_peak_int
      cum_peak_int   <- cum_peak_int + inc_peak

      wing_sts  <- wing_sts - dec_outer_sts + inc_peak
      total_sts <- 2L * wing_sts + 1L

      start_act <- sprintf("-%d sts ([hdc2tog] x%d)", dec_outer_sts, dec_outer_sts)
      peak_act  <- sprintf("(%d hdc, ch 1, %d hdc) [+%d/wing]", inc_peak, inc_peak, inc_peak)
      end_act   <- sprintf("-%d sts ([hdc2tog] x%d)", dec_outer_sts, dec_outer_sts)

      x_in_bot  <- 0.0; y_in_bot <- c_bot
      x_in_top  <- 0.0; y_in_top <- c_top
      x_out_top <- x_out_bot + (dT - dec_outer_sts * ds) / sqrt(2)
      y_out_top <- c_top - x_out_top

    } else {
      phase_label <- "Phase 4: Neck Short Rows"
      sr_idx      <- r - n_peak_rows
      cum_neck_exact <- cum_neck_exact + rate_miter
      dec_neck       <- as.integer(floor(cum_neck_exact + 0.5)) - cum_neck_int
      cum_neck_int   <- cum_neck_int + dec_neck

      wing_sts  <- wing_sts - dec_outer_sts - dec_neck
      total_sts <- 2L * wing_sts  # Worked separately on Left & Right shoulders

      if (sr_idx %% 2L == 1L) {
        # Odd short row: work from outer armhole edge up toward collarbone, stop short
        start_act <- sprintf("Outer: [hdc2tog] x%d (-%d sts)", dec_outer_sts, dec_outer_sts)
        peak_act  <- sprintf("Turn %d st(s) before neck edge", dec_neck)
        end_act   <- "Repeat symm. on 2nd shoulder"
      } else {
        # Even short row: sl st down along flat collar, work down to outer armhole decrease
        start_act <- sprintf("Neck: sl st %d, ch 1 (-%d sts)", dec_neck, dec_neck)
        peak_act  <- "Center unworked (flat collar)"
        end_act   <- sprintf("Outer: [hdc2tog] x%d (-%d sts)", dec_outer_sts, dec_outer_sts)
      }

      x_in_bot  <- c_bot - y_collar_actual; y_in_bot <- y_collar_actual
      x_in_top  <- c_top - y_collar_actual; y_in_top <- y_collar_actual
      x_out_top <- x_out_bot + (dT - dec_outer_sts * ds) / sqrt(2)
      y_out_top <- c_top - x_out_top
    }

    rows_list[[r + 1L]] <- tibble::tibble(
      Row              = paste0("Row ", r),
      row_num          = r,
      Phase            = phase_label,
      color_code       = c_code,
      Color            = color_lookup[[c_code]],
      Row_Start_Action = start_act,
      Center_Action    = peak_act,
      Row_End_Action   = end_act,
      Wing_Sts         = wing_sts,
      Total_Sts        = total_sts,
      Active_HDC_Equiv = total_sts
    )

    # Store right and mirrored left wing polygons for ggplot2 blueprints
    poly_list[[2L * r - 1L]] <- tibble::tibble(
      row_num = r, side = "Right", poly_id = paste0("R_", r),
      Phase = phase_label, color_code = c_code, hex = hex_lookup[[c_code]],
      x = c(x_in_bot, x_out_bot, x_out_top, x_in_top),
      y = c(y_in_bot, y_out_bot, y_out_top, y_in_top)
    )
    poly_list[[2L * r]] <- tibble::tibble(
      row_num = r, side = "Left", poly_id = paste0("L_", r),
      Phase = phase_label, color_code = c_code, hex = hex_lookup[[c_code]],
      x = -c(x_in_bot, x_out_bot, x_out_top, x_in_top),
      y =  c(y_in_bot, y_out_bot, y_out_top, y_in_top)
    )

    x_out_bot <- x_out_top
    y_out_bot <- y_out_top
  }

  # Final Framing Row: 1 continuous row of C2 (Ochre) sc framing both armholes + neckline
  side_bust_len_cm  <- sqrt((x_out_bot - (cutout_height_cm + n_rib_rows * step_c))^2 + y_out_bot^2)
  diag_arm_len_cm   <- sqrt((x_out_bot - (c_top - y_collar_actual))^2 + (y_collar_actual - y_out_bot)^2)
  collar_actual_cm  <- 2 * (c_top - y_collar_actual)
  armhole_sc_per_sd <- as.integer(round((side_bust_len_cm + diag_arm_len_cm) * sts_per_cm))
  collar_sc_sts     <- as.integer(round(collar_actual_cm * sts_per_cm))
  trim_total_sc     <- 2L * armhole_sc_per_sd + collar_sc_sts

  rows_list[[n_hdc_rows + 2L]] <- tibble::tibble(
    Row              = paste0("Row ", n_hdc_rows + 1L, " (Trim)"),
    row_num          = n_hdc_rows + 1L,
    Phase            = "Phase 4: Collar & Armhole Edging",
    color_code       = "C2",
    Color            = color_lookup[["C2"]],
    Row_Start_Action = paste0("RS join at R underarm: ", armhole_sc_per_sd, " sc up R armhole"),
    Center_Action    = paste0(collar_sc_sts, " sc across flat horizontal neckline"),
    Row_End_Action   = paste0(armhole_sc_per_sd, " sc down L armhole"),
    Wing_Sts         = armhole_sc_per_sd,
    Total_Sts        = trim_total_sc,
    Active_HDC_Equiv = as.integer(round(trim_total_sc * 0.75))
  )

  # Perpendicular sc BLO Ribbed Waistband & Cutout Stabilization Calculations (2.5 mm hook, C1)
  band_width_sts    <- as.integer(round(band_height_cm * band_sts_per_cm))
  back_ext_cm       <- (band_total_length_cm - front_width_cm) / 2
  rows_back_ext     <- 2L * as.integer(round((back_ext_cm * band_rows_per_cm) / 2))
  rows_front_wing   <- 2L * as.integer(round((rib_wing_target_cm * band_rows_per_cm) / 2))
  rows_cutout_brdg  <- 2L * as.integer(round((cutout_base_cm * band_rows_per_cm) / 2))
  band_total_rows   <- 2L * rows_back_ext + 2L * rows_front_wing + rows_cutout_brdg

  cutout_leg_sc     <- as.integer(round(cutout_leg_cm * band_sts_per_cm))
  cutout_base_sc    <- as.integer(round(cutout_base_cm * band_sts_per_cm))
  cutout_round_sts  <- 2L * (cutout_leg_sc - 1L) + 1L + cutout_base_sc # incl. sc3tog apex

  icord_rows_each   <- as.integer(round(icord_length_cm * band_rows_per_cm))

  list(
    rows_df           = bind_rows(rows_list),
    polys_df          = bind_rows(poly_list),
    dT                = dT,
    step_c            = step_c,
    rate_miter        = rate_miter,
    leg0_sts          = leg0_sts,
    fsc_total_sts     = fsc_total_sts,
    n_rib_rows        = n_rib_rows,
    n_peak_rows       = n_peak_rows,
    n_neck_rows       = n_neck_rows,
    n_hdc_rows        = n_hdc_rows,
    dec_outer_sts     = dec_outer_sts,
    front_actual_cm   = 2 * (cutout_height_cm + n_rib_rows * step_c),
    y_collar_actual   = y_collar_actual,
    collar_actual_cm  = collar_actual_cm,
    x_underarm_top    = x_out_bot,
    y_underarm_top    = y_out_bot,
    armhole_sc_per_sd = armhole_sc_per_sd,
    collar_sc_sts     = collar_sc_sts,
    band_width_sts    = band_width_sts,
    back_ext_cm       = back_ext_cm,
    rows_back_ext     = rows_back_ext,
    rows_front_wing   = rows_front_wing,
    rows_cutout_brdg  = rows_cutout_brdg,
    band_total_rows   = band_total_rows,
    cutout_leg_sc     = cutout_leg_sc,
    cutout_base_sc    = cutout_base_sc,
    cutout_round_sts  = cutout_round_sts,
    icord_rows_each   = icord_rows_each
  )
}

pat <- build_chevron_halter(
  sts_per_cm = sts_per_cm, rows_per_cm = rows_per_cm,
  band_sts_per_cm = band_sts_per_cm, band_rows_per_cm = band_rows_per_cm,
  front_width_cm = front_width_cm, cutout_height_cm = cutout_height_cm,
  body_height_cm = body_height_cm, neck_flat_width_cm = neck_flat_width_cm,
  band_height_cm = band_height_cm, band_total_length_cm = band_total_length_cm,
  icord_length_cm = icord_length_cm, palette_df = palette_df,
  stripe_cycle_codes = stripe_cycle_codes, rows_per_stripe = rows_per_stripe
)
```

---

## 2. Stitch Map Visualization (Tile Grid)

Matching the `geom_tile` stitch-grid format of the other patterns in this repository, the front panel and bridged base band are mapped onto a discrete `(Stitch, Row)` matrix (`1 Tile = 1 Stitch` across the front panel, colored by actual yarn shade and stitch density zone), followed by an unwrapped row-by-stitch chart for counting directly off your screen.

```{r}
#| label: stitch-map
#| fig-width: 9.5
#| fig-height: 6.2
#| fig-cap: "Discrete Stitch Map (Front Panel): 1 tile = 1 stitch on the 38 cm front grid, showing the Forest Green base band bridging the empty 90-degree almost-underboob cutout, the 45-degree 2-row mitered chevron stripes, armhole decreases, and flat short-rowed collar."

# Convert garment geometry into discrete front-panel stitch columns & vertical row equivalents
n_front_sts  <- 2L * as.integer(round((pat$front_actual_cm / 2) * sts_per_cm)) + 1L # odd for center spine col
center_col   <- (n_front_sts + 1L) %/% 2L
n_band_rows  <- as.integer(round(band_height_cm * rows_per_cm))
n_body_vrows <- as.integer(round(pat$y_collar_actual * rows_per_cm)) + 1L
tot_grid_rows <- n_band_rows + n_body_vrows

# Outer boundary helper at height y_cm above band
half_collar_cm <- pat$collar_actual_cm / 2
y_col_cm       <- pat$y_collar_actual
half_front_cm  <- pat$front_actual_cm / 2
x_ua_cm        <- pat$x_underarm_top
y_ua_cm        <- pat$y_underarm_top

grid <- expand.grid(
  Stitch = seq_len(n_front_sts),
  Row    = seq_len(tot_grid_rows)
) %>%
  mutate(
    # Physical coordinates (cm) of each discrete stitch tile center
    x_cm    = (Stitch - center_col) / sts_per_cm,
    y_cm    = (Row - n_band_rows - 0.5) / rows_per_cm,
    abs_x   = abs(x_cm),
    c_diag  = abs_x + y_cm,

    # Maximum outer half-width of the front body at height y_cm
    max_x_at_y = case_when(
      y_cm < 0 ~ half_front_cm,
      y_cm <= y_ua_cm ~ half_front_cm + (x_ua_cm - half_front_cm) * (y_cm / max(y_ua_cm, 0.01)),
      y_cm <= y_col_cm ~ x_ua_cm + (half_collar_cm - x_ua_cm) * ((y_cm - y_ua_cm) / max(y_col_cm - y_ua_cm, 0.01)),
      TRUE ~ -1.0
    ),

    # Chevron row index (1..n_hdc_rows) corresponding to 45-deg coordinate c_diag
    chev_row = as.integer(ceiling((c_diag - cutout_height_cm) / pat$step_c)),
    stripe_idx = ((pmax(chev_row, 1L) - 1L) %/% rows_per_stripe) %% length(stripe_cycle_codes) + 1L,
    chev_code  = stripe_cycle_codes[stripe_idx],

    # Structural region classification
    Part = case_when(
      Row <= n_band_rows ~ "Base Band (C1 sc BLO)",
      y_cm > y_col_cm ~ "Empty Space",
      abs_x > max_x_at_y ~ "Empty Space",
      c_diag < cutout_height_cm - 0.35 ~ "Empty Space",
      c_diag < cutout_height_cm + 0.28 ~ "Cutout Lock Border (C1 sc/sl st)",
      y_cm >= y_col_cm - (1 / rows_per_cm) & abs_x <= half_collar_cm + 0.35 ~ "Collar & Armhole Trim (C2 sc)",
      abs_x >= max_x_at_y - 0.48 ~ "Collar & Armhole Trim (C2 sc)",
      TRUE ~ paste0("Chevron Stripe: ", chev_code)
    ),

    # Map every active tile to its exact yarn color label
    Yarn_Shade = case_when(
      Part == "Empty Space" ~ NA_character_,
      Part %in% c("Base Band (C1 sc BLO)", "Cutout Lock Border (C1 sc/sl st)") ~ "C1: Forest Green (Band & Cutout Lock)",
      Part == "Collar & Armhole Trim (C2 sc)" ~ "C2: Ochre / Mustard (Body & Trim)",
      chev_code == "C1" ~ "C1: Forest Green (Band & Cutout Lock)",
      chev_code == "C2" ~ "C2: Ochre / Mustard (Body & Trim)",
      chev_code == "C3" ~ "C3: Cream",
      chev_code == "C4" ~ "C4: Dusty Rose"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(Part != "Empty Space")

cutout_top_row <- n_band_rows + as.integer(round(cutout_height_cm * rows_per_cm))
ua_split_row   <- n_band_rows + as.integer(round(y_ua_cm * rows_per_cm))

ggplot(grid, aes(x = Stitch, y = Row, fill = Yarn_Shade)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.22) +
  # Structural phase boundary lines (matching repository pattern style)
  geom_hline(yintercept = n_band_rows + 0.5, color = "grey35", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = cutout_top_row + 0.5, color = "grey45", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = tot_grid_rows - 5.5, color = "grey45", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = center_col, color = "grey35", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5) +

  # Region callout labels (matching repository pattern style)
  annotate(
    "label", x = center_col, y = (n_band_rows + 1) / 2,
    label = sprintf("Bridged Ribbed Band (%s sts front span; +2x14 cm back extensions)", n_front_sts),
    size = 3.0, fontface = "bold", fill = "#FFFFFFDD", label.size = NA
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = center_col, y = n_band_rows + max(3.2, (cutout_top_row - n_band_rows) * 0.36),
    label = sprintf("Almost-Underboob\n90° Cutout Window\n(%.0f x %.0f cm)", 2 * cutout_height_cm, cutout_height_cm),
    size = 3.0, fontface = "bold.italic", color = "#1B3821", lineheight = 0.95
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label", x = round(center_col * 0.36), y = n_band_rows + round(n_body_vrows * 0.42),
    label = "Left Mitered Wing\n(45° bias hdc)",
    size = 2.9, fontface = "bold", fill = "#FFFFFFCC", label.size = NA
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label", x = n_front_sts - round(center_col * 0.36) + 1, y = n_band_rows + round(n_body_vrows * 0.42),
    label = "Right Mitered Wing\n(45° bias hdc)",
    size = 2.9, fontface = "bold", fill = "#FFFFFFCC", label.size = NA
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label", x = center_col, y = cutout_top_row + round((tot_grid_rows - 5 - cutout_top_row) * 0.55),
    label = "90° Center Spine\n(+1 / +2 inc)",
    size = 2.8, fontface = "bold", fill = "#FFFFFFCC", label.size = NA
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label", x = center_col, y = tot_grid_rows - 2.2,
    label = sprintf("Short-Row Flat Collar (%.0f cm)", neck_flat_width_cm),
    size = 2.8, fontface = "bold", fill = "#FFFFFFDD", label.size = NA
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "C1: Forest Green (Band & Cutout Lock)" = "#2E5A36",
    "C2: Ochre / Mustard (Body & Trim)"     = "#B87B28",
    "C3: Cream"                             = "#F3EAD6",
    "C4: Dusty Rose"                        = "#D99B96"
  )) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = sts_per_cm / rows_per_cm) +
  labs(
    title    = "Crochet Stitch Map: Mitered Chevron Almost-Underboob Halter",
    subtitle = sprintf("Front Panel Grid (%d sts = ~%.0f cm wide) | 1 Tile = 1 Stitch Footprint", n_front_sts, front_width_cm),
    x        = sprintf("Stitch Column (Front Width: %d sts = ~%.0f cm)", n_front_sts, front_width_cm),
    y        = "Vertical Row Equivalent (Bottom to Top)"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title    = element_blank(),
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

### Unwrapped Row-by-Stitch Counting Grid (`Rows 0–`r pat$n_hdc_rows + 1L``)

Because chevron rows run along a `45°` diagonal, this companion unwrapped `geom_tile` matrix flattens each pattern row horizontally so **1 tile = 1 exact crochet stitch worked in that row** (with special stitch actions highlighted along the outer edges and center spine).

```{r}
#| label: unwrapped-row-grid
#| fig-width: 10.0
#| fig-height: 5.2
#| fig-cap: "Unwrapped Row-by-Stitch Matrix (Rows 0 to Trim): every horizontal row shows the exact stitch count on the Left Wing, Center Spine/Collar Gap, and Right Wing."

# Build exact stitch-by-stitch tile rows from pat$rows_df
unwrapped_tiles <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(pat$rows_df)), function(i) {
  rw    <- pat$rows_df[i, ]
  r_num <- rw$row_num
  w_sts <- rw$Wing_Sts

  if (rw$Phase == "Phase 4: Neck Short Rows") {
    # Leave visual gap in the center proportional to unworked collar stitches
    sr_step <- r_num - pat$n_peak_rows
    gap_half <- 1L + 2L * sr_step
    left_x   <- seq(-gap_half - w_sts + 1L, -gap_half)
    right_x  <- seq(gap_half, gap_half + w_sts - 1L)
    tibble::tibble(
      Row_Num    = r_num,
      Stitch_Pos = c(left_x, right_x),
      Color_Code = rw$color_code,
      Action     = case_when(
        Stitch_Pos %in% c(min(left_x), min(left_x) + 1L, max(right_x) - 1L, max(right_x)) ~ "Decrease (hdc2tog)",
        TRUE ~ "Standard Stitch"
      )
    )
  } else if (r_num == pat$n_hdc_rows + 1L) {
    # Continuous sc collar & armhole framing row
    half_tot <- rw$Total_Sts %/% 2L
    xs       <- seq(-half_tot, half_tot)
    tibble::tibble(
      Row_Num    = r_num,
      Stitch_Pos = xs,
      Color_Code = rw$color_code,
      Action     = "Standard Stitch"
    )
  } else {
    # Full mitered chevron rows (Phase 1, 2, 3): Left Wing + Center Spine (0) + Right Wing
    left_x  <- seq(-w_sts, -1L)
    right_x <- seq(1L, w_sts)
    xs      <- c(left_x, 0L, right_x)
    tibble::tibble(
      Row_Num    = r_num,
      Stitch_Pos = xs,
      Color_Code = rw$color_code,
      Action     = case_when(
        Stitch_Pos == 0L ~ "Center Spine (ch-1 / fsc)",
        rw$Phase == "Phase 3: Armhole Taper" &
          Stitch_Pos %in% c(min(left_x), min(left_x) + 1L, max(right_x) - 1L, max(right_x)) ~ "Decrease (hdc2tog)",
        rw$Phase == "Phase 2: Rib Baseline" &
          Stitch_Pos %in% c(min(left_x), max(right_x)) ~ "Increase (+1/+2)",
        TRUE ~ "Standard Stitch"
      )
    )
  }
}) %>% bind_rows()

unwrapped_markers <- unwrapped_tiles %>%
  filter(Action != "Standard Stitch")

ggplot(unwrapped_tiles, aes(x = Stitch_Pos, y = Row_Num, fill = Color_Code)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2, width = 1, height = 1) +
  geom_point(
    data = unwrapped_markers,
    aes(x = Stitch_Pos, y = Row_Num, shape = Action),
    size = 1.6, color = "#1A1A1A", stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = pat$n_rib_rows + 0.5, color = "grey35", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = pat$n_peak_rows + 0.5, color = "grey35", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = setNames(palette_df$hex, palette_df$code),
    guide  = "none"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "Center Spine (ch-1 / fsc)" = 18,
    "Increase (+1/+2)"          = 3,
    "Decrease (hdc2tog)"        = 4
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, pat$n_hdc_rows + 1L, by = 2)) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 2.2) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10.5) +
  labs(
    title    = "Unwrapped Row-by-Stitch Matrix (Exact Stitch Counts per Row)",
    subtitle = "Each row flattened horizontally around Center Spine (0); center gap on Rows 12–16 shows unworked flat collar",
    x        = "Centered Stitch Index (Left Wing  <--  0  -->  Right Wing)",
    y        = "Pattern Row Number (0 = fsc, Top = Ochre Trim)"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title    = element_blank(),
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

## 3. Euclidean Blueprint & Construction Schematics

### Figure 1: True-to-Scale Garment Blueprint & 2-Row Stripe Map

```{r}
#| label: fig-garment-blueprint
#| fig-width: 10.5
#| fig-height: 6.4
#| fig-cap: "True-to-scale 2D Euclidean schematic (cm) showing every 2-row color stripe, the dramatic 90-degree almost-underboob inverted-V cutout with anatomical bust-contour reference arcs, the short-row blunted collar framed in Ochre (C2), and the 66.0 cm Forest Green (C1) ribbed underbust band."

half_band   <- band_total_length_cm / 2
half_front  <- pat$front_actual_cm / 2
half_collar <- pat$collar_actual_cm / 2
y_col       <- pat$y_collar_actual

# Anatomical S/M bust contour & apex reference (~88 cm bust: r = 7.5 cm mounds resting on y = 0 at x = +-10 cm)
theta_seq <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 180)
bust_contours <- bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(side = "L", x = -10.0 + 7.5 * cos(theta_seq), y = 7.5 + 7.5 * sin(theta_seq)),
  tibble::tibble(side = "R", x =  10.0 + 7.5 * cos(theta_seq), y = 7.5 + 7.5 * sin(theta_seq))
)
bust_apex_pts <- tibble::tibble(x = c(-10.2, 10.2), y = c(8.2, 8.2))

# Ribbed band polygon & vertical rib texture lines
band_rect <- tibble::tibble(
  xmin = -half_band, xmax = half_band,
  ymin = -band_height_cm, ymax = 0
)
rib_lines <- tibble::tibble(
  x = seq(-half_band + 0.75, half_band - 0.75, by = 0.75)
)

# Buttonhole eyelets at both back ends (3 eyelets per side)
eyelet_y <- seq(-band_height_cm * 0.78, -band_height_cm * 0.22, length.out = 3)
eyelets_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(x = -half_band + 1.1, y = eyelet_y),
  tibble::tibble(x =  half_band - 1.1, y = eyelet_y)
)

# Ochre (C2) continuous sc trim path along armholes + flat collar
ochre_trim_path <- tibble::tibble(
  x = c(half_front, pat$x_underarm_top, half_collar, -half_collar, -pat$x_underarm_top, -half_front),
  y = c(0, pat$y_underarm_top, y_col, y_col, pat$y_underarm_top, 0)
)

# Inner cutout C1 sc stabilization border triangle
cutout_border_path <- tibble::tibble(
  x = c(-cutout_height_cm, 0, cutout_height_cm, -cutout_height_cm),
  y = c(0, cutout_height_cm, 0, 0)
)

# Short I-cord strap stubs indicating strap emergence at collar corners
strap_stubs <- bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(side = "L", x = c(-half_collar, -half_collar - 1.8), y = c(y_col, y_col + 3.4)),
  tibble::tibble(side = "R", x = c( half_collar,  half_collar + 1.8), y = c(y_col, y_col + 3.4))
)

ggplot() +
  # 1. Forest Green perpendicular sc BLO ribbed band
  geom_rect(
    data = band_rect,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    fill = "#2E5A36", color = "#1B3821", linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = rib_lines,
    aes(x = x, xend = x, y = -band_height_cm, yend = 0),
    color = "#3E7448", linewidth = 0.25, alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = eyelets_df, aes(x = x, y = y),
    shape = 21, size = 2.4, fill = "#FAF8F2", color = "#1B3821", stroke = 0.7
  ) +

  # 2. Mitered chevron & short-row polygons (true 2-row stripe colors)
  geom_polygon(
    data = pat$polys_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = poly_id, fill = color_code),
    color = "#2B2B2B33", linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  # Subtle anatomical S/M bust mound & apex reference showing almost-underboob reveal vs safe apex coverage
  geom_path(
    data = bust_contours, aes(x = x, y = y, group = side),
    color = "#5C3A3866", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = bust_apex_pts, aes(x = x, y = y),
    shape = 4, size = 2.0, stroke = 0.7, color = "#5C3A3888"
  ) +
  # Highlight center mitered spine (Rows 1..n_peak_rows)
  annotate(
    "segment", x = 0, xend = 0, y = cutout_height_cm, yend = y_col,
    color = "#2B2B2B88", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  # 3. Inner cutout C1 sc + surface sl st stabilization trim
  geom_path(
    data = cutout_border_path, aes(x = x, y = y),
    color = "#2E5A36", linewidth = 1.5, lineend = "round", linejoin = "mitre"
  ) +

  # 4. Ochre (C2) continuous sc edging framing both armholes & flat neckline
  geom_path(
    data = ochre_trim_path, aes(x = x, y = y),
    color = "#B87B28", linewidth = 1.8, lineend = "round", linejoin = "round"
  ) +

  # 5. I-cord strap stubs at collarbone corners
  geom_path(
    data = strap_stubs, aes(x = x, y = y, group = side),
    color = "#2E5A36", linewidth = 2.3, lineend = "round"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = half_collar + 3.8, y = y_col + 1.0,
    label = paste0("3-st I-cord straps\n(2 x ", icord_length_cm, " cm)"),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.8, fontface = "italic", color = "#2E5A36"
  ) +

  # 6. Dimension callout arrows (in cm)
  # Total ribbed band length (66.0 cm)
  annotate(
    "segment", x = -half_band, xend = half_band, y = -band_height_cm - 2.3, yend = -band_height_cm - 2.3,
    arrow = arrow(ends = "both", length = unit(0.18, "cm")), color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label", x = 0, y = -band_height_cm - 2.3,
    label = sprintf("Total Ribbed Band = %.1f cm (%.0f cm L back + %.0f cm front + %.0f cm R back; %.0f cm lace gap)",
                    band_total_length_cm, pat$back_ext_cm, front_width_cm, pat$back_ext_cm, back_gap_cm),
    size = 2.9, fill = "white", label.size = 0.2, color = "grey15"
  ) +
  # Front rib baseline width (38.0 cm)
  annotate(
    "segment", x = -half_front, xend = half_front, y = -band_height_cm + 0.85, yend = -band_height_cm + 0.85,
    arrow = arrow(ends = "both", length = unit(0.15, "cm")), color = "#F3EAD6", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label", x = 0, y = -band_height_cm / 2 + 0.35,
    label = sprintf("Front Rib Baseline = %.1f cm (incl. %.1f cm bridged cutout)", front_width_cm, 2 * cutout_height_cm),
    size = 2.7, fill = "#2E5A36", color = "#F3EAD6", fontface = "bold", label.size = NA
  ) +
  # Band height (4.5 cm)
  annotate(
    "segment", x = -half_band - 1.5, xend = -half_band - 1.5, y = -band_height_cm, yend = 0,
    arrow = arrow(ends = "both", length = unit(0.14, "cm")), color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = -half_band - 2.1, y = -band_height_cm / 2,
    label = sprintf("%.1f cm\nband", band_height_cm),
    hjust = 1, size = 2.8, color = "grey20"
  ) +
  # Inverted-V almost-underboob cutout callout
  annotate(
    "segment", x = -cutout_height_cm + 0.45, xend = cutout_height_cm - 0.45, y = 0.65, yend = 0.65,
    arrow = arrow(ends = "both", length = unit(0.14, "cm")), color = "#2E5A36", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label", x = 0, y = min(3.2, cutout_height_cm * 0.36),
    label = sprintf("90° Almost-Underboob Cutout\n%.1f cm base x %.1f cm height", 2 * cutout_height_cm, cutout_height_cm),
    size = 2.55, fontface = "bold", fill = "#FFFFFFD9", color = "#1B3821", label.size = 0.15, lineheight = 0.95
  ) +
  # Body height (21.0 cm)
  annotate(
    "segment", x = half_front + 3.2, xend = half_front + 3.2, y = 0, yend = y_col,
    arrow = arrow(ends = "both", length = unit(0.16, "cm")), color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label", x = half_front + 3.2, y = y_col / 2,
    label = sprintf("Body Height\n%.1f cm", body_height_cm),
    size = 2.8, fill = "white", label.size = 0.2, color = "grey15"
  ) +
  # Blunted flat collar width (9.0 cm)
  annotate(
    "segment", x = -half_collar, xend = half_collar, y = y_col + 1.3, yend = y_col + 1.3,
    arrow = arrow(ends = "both", length = unit(0.15, "cm")), color = "#B87B28", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label", x = 0, y = y_col + 2.8,
    label = sprintf("Flat Short-Rowed Collar = %.1f cm", neck_flat_width_cm),
    size = 2.85, fontface = "bold", fill = "#FFFDF9", color = "#8C5811", label.size = 0.2
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "2-Row Stripe Sequence:",

  coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = c(-39, 36), ylim = c(-8.0, y_col + 5.0), clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(
    title    = "Garment Blueprint & True-Scale Stripe Map (Size S/M)",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Gauge: %.1f sts x %.1f rows/cm (3.0 mm hdc) | %.1f sts x %.1f rows/cm (2.5 mm sc BLO) | %d Chevron/Short Rows + Trim",
      sts_per_cm, rows_per_cm, band_sts_per_cm, band_rows_per_cm, pat$n_hdc_rows
    ),
    x = "Horizontal Width from Center Spine (cm)",
    y = "Height from Top of Ribbed Band (cm)"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

### Figure 2: 4-Stage Construction Phase Diagram

```{r}
#| label: fig-construction-phases
#| fig-width: 10.5
#| fig-height: 7.4
#| fig-cap: "Step-by-step construction mechanics across all four phases: (1) odd-count fsc V-arch framing the 90-degree cutout, (2) 180-degree horizontal rib expansion, (3) armhole decreases & symmetrical neck short rows, and (4) perpendicular join-as-you-go ribbed band, inner cutout stabilization, and criss-cross corset lacing."

phase_levels <- c(
  "1. Phase 1: Foundation fsc V-Arch",
  "2. Phase 2: 180° Rib Baseline Expansion",
  "3. Phase 3 & 4: Armhole Taper & Neck Short Rows",
  "4. Ribbed Band, Cutout Border & Corset Lacing"
)

# Assemble cumulative polygon states across the 4 panels
p2_polys <- pat$polys_df %>%
  filter(row_num <= pat$n_rib_rows) %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(phase_levels[2], levels = phase_levels), state = "Active")

p3_polys <- bind_rows(
  pat$polys_df %>%
    filter(row_num <= pat$n_rib_rows) %>%
    mutate(panel = factor(phase_levels[3], levels = phase_levels), state = "Previous"),
  pat$polys_df %>%
    filter(row_num > pat$n_rib_rows) %>%
    mutate(panel = factor(phase_levels[3], levels = phase_levels), state = "Active")
)

p4_polys <- pat$polys_df %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(phase_levels[4], levels = phase_levels), state = "Previous")

facet_polys <- bind_rows(p2_polys, p3_polys, p4_polys)

# Panel 1: fsc arch path
p1_arch <- tibble::tibble(
  panel = factor(phase_levels[1], levels = phase_levels),
  x     = c(-cutout_height_cm, 0, cutout_height_cm),
  y     = c(0, cutout_height_cm, 0)
)
p1_pts <- tibble::tibble(
  panel = factor(phase_levels[1], levels = phase_levels),
  x     = c(-cutout_height_cm, 0, cutout_height_cm),
  y     = c(0, cutout_height_cm, 0),
  lbl   = c(
    paste0(" st 1\n (-", cutout_height_cm, ", 0)"),
    paste0("Marked Center fsc\n(st ", pat$leg0_sts + 1L, " of ", pat$fsc_total_sts, ")"),
    paste0("st ", pat$fsc_total_sts, " \n(+", cutout_height_cm, ", 0) ")
  ),
  vj = c(1.3, -0.5, 1.3)
)

# Panel 2: horizontal expansion vectors
p2_arrows <- tibble::tibble(
  panel = factor(phase_levels[2], levels = phase_levels),
  x     = c(-cutout_height_cm - 1, cutout_height_cm + 1, 0),
  xend  = c(-half_front, half_front, 0),
  y     = c(-1.6, -1.6, cutout_height_cm + 1),
  yend  = c(-1.6, -1.6, cutout_height_cm + pat$n_rib_rows * pat$step_c)
)

# Panel 3: armhole inward taper & flat short-row collar vectors
p3_trim <- ochre_trim_path %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(phase_levels[3], levels = phase_levels))

p3_arrows <- tibble::tibble(
  panel = factor(phase_levels[3], levels = phase_levels),
  x     = c(-half_front - 1.2, half_front + 1.2),
  xend  = c(-pat$x_underarm_top - 1.2, pat$x_underarm_top + 1.2),
  y     = c(0.5, 0.5),
  yend  = c(pat$y_underarm_top, pat$y_underarm_top)
)

# Panel 4: band, inner stabilization round & schematic corset criss-cross lacing
p4_band <- band_rect %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(phase_levels[4], levels = phase_levels))
p4_cutout_ring <- cutout_border_path %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(phase_levels[4], levels = phase_levels))
p4_trim <- ochre_trim_path %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(phase_levels[4], levels = phase_levels))

# Illustrative lacing cords curving from collar corners toward back band eyelets
p4_cords <- bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(
    panel = factor(phase_levels[4], levels = phase_levels), cord = "L_to_R",
    x = c(-half_collar, 0, half_band - 1.1, -half_band + 1.1, half_band - 1.1),
    y = c(y_col, y_col + 3.2, eyelet_y[3], eyelet_y[2], eyelet_y[1])
  ),
  tibble::tibble(
    panel = factor(phase_levels[4], levels = phase_levels), cord = "R_to_L",
    x = c(half_collar, 0, -half_band + 1.1, half_band - 1.1, -half_band + 1.1),
    y = c(y_col, y_col + 3.2, eyelet_y[3], eyelet_y[2], eyelet_y[1])
  )
)

# Phase callout annotations
panel_notes <- tibble::tibble(
  panel = factor(phase_levels, levels = phase_levels),
  x     = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
  y     = c(max(19.5, cutout_height_cm + 7.5), 23.0, 24.3, -6.7),
  label = c(
    sprintf("%d fsc (%d/leg + 1 center st)\n%.2f cm legs @ 90° apex",
            pat$fsc_total_sts, pat$leg0_sts, cutout_height_cm * sqrt(2)),
    sprintf("Rows 1–%d: +1/+2 sts @ ends & peak\n180° flat base grows to %.1f cm", pat$n_rib_rows, front_width_cm),
    sprintf("Rows %d–%d: [hdc2tog] x2 outer taper\nRows %d–%d: short rows + C2 sc trim",
            pat$n_rib_rows + 1L, pat$n_peak_rows, pat$n_peak_rows + 1L, pat$n_hdc_rows),
    sprintf("JAYG %d-row sc BLO band bridges %.0f cm cutout\n+ 2.5 mm sc/sl st cutout lock + I-cord lacing",
            pat$band_total_rows, 2 * cutout_height_cm)
  )
)

ggplot() +
  # Ghost garment outline for spatial reference in Panel 1
  geom_polygon(
```

## 4. Materials, Hooks & Dynamic Yardage Table

Yarn consumption is derived directly from stitch geometry: each `3.0 mm` `hdc` consumes yarn proportional to its stitch footprint $(1/\text{sts\_per\_cm} + 1/\text{rows\_per\_cm})$, while `2.5 mm` `sc BLO` ribbing, the inner cutout stabilization border, and both `160 cm` 3-stitch I-cord straps are summed and multiplied by the **+15% buffer**.

```{r}
#| label: yardage-table
# Physics-based yarn length per stitch calibrated to #2 Sport cotton
m_per_hdc   <- 0.0225 * ((1 / sts_per_cm + 1 / rows_per_cm) / (1 / 2.2 + 1 / 1.6))
m_per_fsc   <- 0.88 * m_per_hdc
m_per_sc30  <- 0.72 * m_per_hdc
m_per_sc25  <- 0.0175 * ((1 / band_sts_per_cm + 1 / band_rows_per_cm) / (1 / 2.4 + 1 / 2.6))
m_per_sl25  <- 0.62 * m_per_sc25

# Body yarn by color code
body_yarn <- pat$rows_df %>%
  mutate(
    raw_meters = case_when(
      row_num == 0L ~ Total_Sts * m_per_fsc,
      row_num == pat$n_hdc_rows + 1L ~ Total_Sts * m_per_sc30,
      TRUE ~ Total_Sts * m_per_hdc
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(color_code) %>%
  summarise(
    Body_Stitches = sum(Total_Sts),
    Body_Meters   = sum(raw_meters),
    .groups       = "drop"
  )

# C1 structural components (band + inner cutout border + 2 x 160 cm 3-st I-cords)
band_meters   <- (pat$band_total_rows * pat$band_width_sts) * m_per_sc25
cutout_meters <- pat$cutout_round_sts * (m_per_sc25 + m_per_sl25)
icord_meters  <- 2 * pat$icord_rows_each * icord_stitches * (1.06 * m_per_sc25)

yardage_summary <- palette_df %>%
  left_join(body_yarn, by = c("code" = "color_code")) %>%
  mutate(
    Trim_Band_Strap_Meters = if_else(code == "C1", band_meters + cutout_meters + icord_meters, 0.0),
    Net_Meters             = Body_Meters + Trim_Band_Strap_Meters,
    Buffered_Meters        = ceiling(Net_Meters * yardage_buffer),
    Estimated_Grams        = ceiling(Buffered_Meters / meters_per_gram),
    Skeins_50g             = ceiling(Buffered_Meters / skein_meters)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Color_Code       = code,
    Shade            = name,
    Hex              = hex,
    Pattern_Role     = role,
    `Meters (+15%)`  = Buffered_Meters,
    `Grams (+15%)`   = Estimated_Grams,
    `50g Balls`      = Skeins_50g
  )

kable(
  yardage_summary,
  align   = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r"),
  caption = sprintf(
    "Dynamic Yarn Requirements — %s (%.0f m / %.0f g skein; includes +%.0f%% buffer)",
    yarn_weight_class, skein_meters, skein_grams, (yardage_buffer - 1) * 100
  )
)
```

- **Main Body Hook:** `r sprintf("%.1f mm", hook_body_mm)` — Gauge: `r sprintf("%.0f sts x %.0f rows = 10 x 10 cm", sts_per_cm * 10, rows_per_cm * 10)` in blocked `hdc`.
- **Band, Cutout & Strap Hook:** `r sprintf("%.1f mm", hook_trim_mm)` — Gauge: `r sprintf("%.0f sts x %.0f rows = 10 x 10 cm", band_sts_per_cm * 10, band_rows_per_cm * 10)` in `sc BLO` ribbing.
- **Notions:** Locking stitch markers (at least 3: center spine peak + left/right underarm corners), tapestry needle, rust-proof blocking pins.

## 5. Abbreviations & Cotton Structural Notes (US Crochet Terms)

- **[Ch](/vocabulary.qmd#ch)** — Chain
- **[Sl St](/vocabulary.qmd#sl-st)** — Slip stitch
- **[SC](/vocabulary.qmd#sc)** — Single crochet
- **SC BLO** — Single crochet worked in the **back loop only** (creates elastic vertical knit-look ribbing when turned perpendicular)
- **FSC** — Foundation single crochet (creates chain + first `sc` row simultaneously with matching stretch)
- **[HDC](/vocabulary.qmd#hdc)** — Half double crochet
- **HDC2Tog** — Half double crochet 2 stitches together (`[hdc2tog] x2` works two consecutive decreases over 4 stitches, decreasing by 2 stitches)
- **SC3Tog** — Single crochet 3 stitches together (mitered inner-corner decrease at cutout apex)
- **JAYG** — Join-as-you-go slip-stitch attachment

### Structural Anti-Sag Engineering for 100% Cotton

1. **Zero-Bulk Stripe Transitions (Crocheting Over Tails):** Because every stripe is exactly **2 rows** (`C2 -> C3 -> C4 -> C1`), all color joins up to Row `r pat$n_peak_rows` land at the **same right-hand edge**. Change colors on the final yarn-over pull-through of the second row in each stripe, leave a `10 cm` tail, and **crochet directly over both the old and new yarn tails** for the first `6–8 sts` of the next row. In inelastic 100% cotton, locking tails inside the outer edge reinforces the rib baseline and armhole selvedges while eliminating weaving-in bulk.
2. **Preventing Sternum Cutout Bridge Dip:** Across the `r sprintf("%.1f cm", 2 * cutout_height_cm)` empty sternum cutout, the Forest Green (`C1`) ribbed band bridges open air without upper fabric pulling it upward. Switching down to the **`r sprintf("%.1f mm", hook_trim_mm)` hook** and working **1 snug round of `sc` (`sc3tog` at the apex) + 1 round of surface `sl st`** around the interior perimeter of the cutout triangle locks the `45°` bias edges and anchors the bridged band horizontally so it never sags or gapes on the body.
3. **Why Outer Armholes Use `[hdc2tog] x2`:** At `r sts_per_cm` sts/cm and `r rows_per_cm` rows/cm, one `hdc` row is `r sprintf("%.3f cm", pat$dT)` thick whereas one `hdc` stitch is only `r sprintf("%.3f cm", 1 / sts_per_cm)` wide. A single `hdc2tog` (`-1` st) fails to overcome the outward $45^\circ$ row projection. Working `[hdc2tog] x2` (`-2` sts at each outer edge) cleanly pivots the side-bust inward toward the collarbone.

## 7. Step-by-Step Written Instructions

### Phase 1 — Foundation Arch (`Row 0`, `3.0 mm` hook)

1. With **`C2` (Ochre)** and the **`r sprintf("%.1f mm", hook_body_mm)` hook**, work **`r pat$fsc_total_sts` `fsc`**.
2. Place a locking stitch marker in the **`r pat$leg0_sts + 1L`th (center) stitch** (`r pat$leg0_sts` sts on Right Wing + `1` center spine st + `r pat$leg0_sts` sts on Left Wing). Turn. *(Note: `Row 0` establishes the flexible `r sprintf("%.2f cm", cutout_height_cm * sqrt(2))`-per-leg cutout foundation rim; `Rows 1–2` begin the 2-row stripe count in `C2`.)*

### Phase 2 — Flat Rib Baseline Expansion (`Rows 1–`r pat$n_rib_rows``, `3.0 mm` hook)

Work back and forth in **2-row stripes** following the color rotation **`C2 -> C3 -> C4 -> C1`**, changing colors at the right-hand edge after every even-numbered row and crocheting over yarn tails for `6–8 sts`:

- **Row 1 (RS, `C2`):** `Ch 1` *(does not count as a st throughout)*, follow the **Row Start Action** in the first `fsc` (`2 hdc` for `+1` inc, or `3 hdc` for `+2` inc), `hdc` in each remaining `fsc` up to the marked center stitch, work the **Center Peak Action** — either `(1 hdc, ch 1, 1 hdc)` or `(2 hdc, ch 1, 2 hdc)` as listed in the table — directly into the marked center `fsc` (move marker to the new `ch-1` space), `hdc` down the second wing to the last st, and work the **Row End Action** in the last st. Turn. (`r pat$rows_df$Wing_Sts[2]` sts per wing; `r pat$rows_df$Total_Sts[2]` sts total incl. `ch-1` sp).
- **Rows 2–`r pat$n_rib_rows`:** `Ch 1`, work the listed **Row Start Action** (`2 hdc` or `3 hdc` in first st), `hdc` in each st to the center `ch-1` space, work the listed **Center Peak Action** into the `ch-1` space, `hdc` in each st to the last st, and work the listed **Row End Action** in the final st. Turn.
- After **Row `r pat$n_rib_rows`** (`r pat$rows_df$Color[pat$n_rib_rows + 1L]`), your flat `180°` bottom rib edge measures **`r sprintf("%.1f cm", pat$front_actual_cm)`** (`r sprintf("%.1f cm", (pat$front_actual_cm - 2 * cutout_height_cm) / 2)` left wing + `r sprintf("%.1f cm", 2 * cutout_height_cm)` almost-underboob center cutout + `r sprintf("%.1f cm", (pat$front_actual_cm - 2 * cutout_height_cm) / 2)` right wing) with **`r pat$rows_df$Wing_Sts[pat$n_rib_rows + 1L]` sts per wing**. Place markers at both outer bottom underarm/rib corners.

### Phase 3 — Armhole Side-Bust Taper (`Rows `r pat$n_rib_rows + 1L`–`r pat$n_peak_rows``, `3.0 mm` hook)

Continue the 2-row stripe sequence, maintaining the center `ch-1` spine increases while switching outer row ends to double decreases so the sides pivot upward and inward along the side-bust:

- **Rows `r pat$n_rib_rows + 1L`–`r pat$n_peak_rows`:** `Ch 1`, **`[hdc2tog] x2`** over the first 4 sts (`-2` sts), `hdc` in each st to the center `ch-1` space, work the listed **Center Peak Action** in the `ch-1` space, `hdc` in each st until 4 sts remain, **`[hdc2tog] x2`** over the last 4 sts (`-2` sts). Turn.
- At the end of **Row `r pat$n_peak_rows`** (`r pat$rows_df$Color[pat$n_peak_rows + 1L]`), the center spine peak reaches **`r sprintf("%.1f cm", pat$y_collar_actual)`** (`~`r sprintf("%.1f cm", body_height_cm)` target, `r pat$rows_df$Wing_Sts[pat$n_peak_rows + 1L]` sts per wing). Position yarn at the outer armhole edge for the first shoulder's short rows.

### Phase 4 — Short-Row Blunted Neckline & Ochre Framing Row (`Rows `r pat$n_peak_rows + 1L`–`r pat$n_hdc_rows` + Trim`)

Work each shoulder separately across **`r pat$n_neck_rows` short rows** to level off a crisp **`r sprintf("%.1f cm", neck_flat_width_cm)`** horizontal collarbone edge:

1. **First Shoulder (`Rows `r pat$n_peak_rows + 1L`–`r pat$n_hdc_rows``):**
   - **Odd Short Rows (`Rows `r paste(seq(pat$n_peak_rows + 1L, pat$n_hdc_rows, by = 2L), collapse = ", ")`` — worked Outer Armhole $\to$ Neck):** `Ch 1`, `[hdc2tog] x2` over first 4 sts, `hdc` up the wing stopping **`1` or `2` sts short** of the previous row's neck end as specified in the table. Leave remaining neck st(s) unworked. Turn.
   - **Even Short Rows (`Rows `r paste(seq(pat$n_peak_rows + 2L, pat$n_hdc_rows, by = 2L), collapse = ", ")`` — worked Neck $\to$ Outer Armhole):** Do **not** `ch 1`; `sl st` loosely across the first `1` or `2` neck sts as listed in the table, `ch 1`, `hdc` in next st and down the wing until 4 sts remain, `[hdc2tog] x2` over last 4 sts. Change color at the outer armhole edge after every 2-row stripe. Fasten off after **Row `r pat$n_hdc_rows`** (`r pat$rows_df$Color[pat$n_hdc_rows + 1L]`, `r pat$rows_df$Wing_Sts[pat$n_hdc_rows + 1L]` live diagonal armhole sts remaining).
2. **Second Shoulder (`Rows `r pat$n_peak_rows + 1L`–`r pat$n_hdc_rows``):** Join **`r pat$rows_df$Color[pat$n_peak_rows + 2L]`** at the opposite outer armhole edge and mirror `Rows `r pat$n_peak_rows + 1L`–`r pat$n_hdc_rows`` identically. Fasten off.
3. **Collar & Armhole Framing Row (`Row `r pat$n_hdc_rows + 1L``, `C2` Ochre, `3.0 mm` hook):** With **RS facing**, join **`C2` (Ochre)** at the right bottom underarm marker. `Ch 1`, work **`r pat$armhole_sc_per_sd` `sc`** evenly up the right side-bust row ends and across the `r pat$rows_df$Wing_Sts[pat$n_hdc_rows + 1L]` live diagonal shoulder stitches to the right collarbone corner (`2 sc` in corner), work **`r pat$collar_sc_sts` `sc`** evenly across the stepped short-row ends + center `ch-1` peak to form a smooth **`r sprintf("%.1f cm", neck_flat_width_cm)`** horizontal collar (`2 sc` in left collarbone corner), and work **`r pat$armhole_sc_per_sd` `sc`** down the left live diagonal shoulder stitches and left side-bust row ends to the left underarm marker. Fasten off `C2`.

### Phase 5 — Join-As-You-Go Perpendicular `sc BLO` Band & Cutout Stabilization (`2.5 mm` hook, `C1`)

```{r}
#| label: band-eyelet-spacing
# Compute symmetrical 3-eyelet buttonhole row across band_width_sts
n_eyelets   <- 3L
eyelet_ch   <- 1L
rem_sc      <- pat$band_width_sts - n_eyelets * eyelet_ch
seg_base    <- rem_sc %/% (n_eyelets + 1L)
seg_extra   <- rem_sc %%  (n_eyelets + 1L)
seg_vec     <- rep(seg_base, n_eyelets + 1L)
if (seg_extra > 0) seg_vec[seq_len(seg_extra)] <- seg_vec[seq_len(seg_extra)] + 1L
eyelet_instr <- paste0(
  "sc BLO ", seg_vec[1], ", ",
  paste(sprintf("[ch %d, sk %d, sc BLO %d]", eyelet_ch, eyelet_ch, seg_vec[-1]), collapse = ", ")
)
```

Switch to the **`r sprintf("%.1f mm", hook_trim_mm)` hook** and **`C1` (Forest Green)**. The `r sprintf("%.1f cm", band_height_cm)` band is worked **perpendicular** to the body (`r pat$band_width_sts` sts wide $\times$ `r pat$band_total_rows` rows = `r sprintf("%.1f cm", band_total_length_cm)`):

1. **Left Back Extension (`Band Rows 1–`r pat$rows_back_ext``, `r sprintf("%.1f cm", pat$back_ext_cm)`):**
   - `Ch `r pat$band_width_sts + 1L``. **Row 1:** `sc` in 2nd `ch` from hook and each `ch` across (`r pat$band_width_sts` sts). `Ch 1`, turn.
   - **Row 2 (Left Corset Buttonhole Row):** Work 3 evenly spaced lacing eyelets: *`r eyelet_instr`* (`r pat$band_width_sts` sts incl. `ch-1` spaces). `Ch 1`, turn.
   - **Rows 3–`r pat$rows_back_ext`:** `sc BLO` in each st (and into each `ch-1` eyelet on Row 3) across (`r pat$band_width_sts` sts), `ch 1`, turn at the outer edge. At the top edge of Row `r pat$rows_back_ext`, align with the **left bottom underarm marker** on the RS of the body.
2. **Left Front Rib Wing — JAYG (`Band Rows `r pat$rows_back_ext + 1L`–`r pat$rows_back_ext + pat$rows_front_wing``, `r sprintf("%.1f cm", (front_width_cm - 2 * cutout_height_cm) / 2)`):**
   - At the body edge after every odd band row, **`sl st` into the next two `2.4 sts/cm`-spaced edge points** along the horizontal bottom rib baseline of Phase 2 (`sl st 1` to join, `sl st 1` to advance, turn — *do not `ch 1` at the body edge*), then `sc BLO` `r pat$band_width_sts` down to the bottom hem, `ch 1`, turn, and `sc BLO` `r pat$band_width_sts` back up to the body. Stop precisely at the **left base corner of the inverted-V cutout**.
3. **Sternum Cutout Bridge (`Band Rows `r pat$rows_back_ext + pat$rows_front_wing + 1L`–`r pat$rows_back_ext + pat$rows_front_wing + pat$rows_cutout_brdg``, `r sprintf("%.1f cm", 2 * cutout_height_cm)`):**
   - Work **`r pat$rows_cutout_brdg` rows** of `sc BLO` (`r pat$band_width_sts` sts, `ch 1`, turn at **both** top and bottom edges) **unattached across open air** to bridge the `r sprintf("%.1f cm", 2 * cutout_height_cm)` base of the sternum cutout. Keep tension firm so the bridge matches `r sprintf("%.1f cm", 2 * cutout_height_cm)` unstretched.
4. **Right Front Rib Wing — JAYG (`Band Rows `r pat$rows_back_ext + pat$rows_front_wing + pat$rows_cutout_brdg + 1L`–`r pat$rows_back_ext + 2L * pat$rows_front_wing + pat$rows_cutout_brdg``, `r sprintf("%.1f cm", (front_width_cm - 2 * cutout_height_cm) / 2)`):**
   - Resume `sl st` join-as-you-go attachment starting at the **right base corner of the inverted-V cutout** all the way out to the **right bottom underarm marker**.
5. **Right Back Extension & Right Eyelets (`Band Rows `r pat$band_total_rows - pat$rows_back_ext + 1L`–`r pat$band_total_rows``, `r sprintf("%.1f cm", pat$back_ext_cm)`):**
   - Continue `sc BLO` unattached for `r pat$rows_back_ext - 2L` rows.
   - **Row `r pat$band_total_rows - 1L` (Right Corset Buttonhole Row):** Work *`r eyelet_instr`* to mirror the 3 left eyelets.
   - **Row `r pat$band_total_rows`:** `sc BLO` in each st/ch across (`r pat$band_width_sts` sts). Fasten off.
6. **Inner Cutout Anti-Sag Stabilization Round (`2.5 mm` hook, `C1`):**
   - With **RS facing**, join `C1` at the right bottom corner inside the cutout triangle. Work **`r pat$cutout_leg_sc - 1L` `sc`** evenly up the underside of the right foundation arch leg, work **`sc3tog`** across *(last st before apex, center spine st, first st down left leg)* to lock a crisp `90°` apex, work **`r pat$cutout_leg_sc - 1L` `sc`** down the left leg, and work **`r pat$cutout_base_sc` `sc`** across the top row-ends of the bridged band (`r pat$cutout_round_sts` sts), `sl st` to join.
   - Work **1 round of firm surface `sl st`** around all `r pat$cutout_round_sts` sts of the cutout triangle. Fasten off and weave in ends securely.

### Phase 6 — 3-Stitch I-Cord Straps & Wet-Blocking (`2.5 mm` hook, `C1`)

1. **Right & Left 3-Stitch I-Cords (`2 x `r sprintf("%.0f cm", icord_length_cm)``):**
   - With **`C1` (Forest Green)** and the **`r sprintf("%.1f mm", hook_trim_mm)` hook**, insert hook into the **right collarbone corner** of the Ochre collar trim and pull up 3 loops across the 2 corner stitches (`3` loops on hook).
   - **I-Cord Repeat (`~`r pat$icord_rows_each`` rows):** Drop the 2nd and 3rd loops from the hook (pinch firmly with left thumb and forefinger so they do not unravel), `yo` and pull through 1st loop; insert hook into 2nd loop, `yo` and pull through; insert hook into 3rd loop, `yo` and pull through (`3` live loops restored). Repeat until cord measures **`r sprintf("%.0f cm", icord_length_cm)`**, then `yo` and pull through all 3 loops at once. Fasten off.
   - Repeat identically at the **left collarbone corner**.
2. **Wet-Blocking Dimensions & Corset Lacing:**
   - Soak the finished cotton halter in cool water with mild no-rinse wash for 15 minutes; gently squeeze in a towel without wringing.
   - Pin flat to a blocking mat to exact target geometry:
     - **Total Ribbed Band:** `r sprintf("%.1f cm", band_total_length_cm)` $\times$ `r sprintf("%.1f cm", band_height_cm)` (straight bottom edge, zero dip across the `r sprintf("%.1f cm", 2 * cutout_height_cm)` cutout bridge).
     - **Inverted-V Cutout:** `r sprintf("%.1f cm", 2 * cutout_height_cm)` base $\times$ `r sprintf("%.1f cm", cutout_height_cm)` apex height (`90°` inner peak).
     - **Front Rib Baseline:** `r sprintf("%.1f cm", front_width_cm)` between underarm markers.
     - **Body Height (above band to flat collar):** `r sprintf("%.1f cm", body_height_cm)`.
     - **Blunted Collar Width:** `r sprintf("%.1f cm", neck_flat_width_cm)`.
   - Once completely dry, cross the two `r sprintf("%.0f cm", icord_length_cm)` I-cord straps in an **"X"** over the upper back and lace them downward through the 3 pairs of buttonhole eyelets across the `r sprintf("%.0f cm", back_gap_cm)` back corset gap, tying a bow at the lower back.
